name: MyDCD Berhad
overview: MyDCD Berhad 于2026年在马来西亚交易所 ACE 市场完成首次公开募股（IPO），发行335,000,000股新股。公司本年度未公告其他业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或合约动态。
overview_en: MyDCD Berhad completed its initial public offering (IPO) on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad in 2026, involving a public issue of 335,000,000 new ordinary shares. The company did not announce any other business segment expansions, reductions, disposals, or contract developments during the year.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 公司今年完成 IPO，发行新股并在 ACE 市场上市。
segments.note_en: The company completed its IPO this year, issuing new shares and listing on the ACE Market.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING ("IPO") IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE LISTING OF MYDCD BERHAD ("MYDCD" OR "COMPANY") ON THE ACE MARKET OF BURSA MALAYSIA S
actions.text: 完成首次公开募股，公开发行335,000,000股新股并在马来西亚交易所 ACE 市场上市。
actions.text_en: Completed initial public offering, involving a public issue of 335,000,000 new ordinary shares and listing on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.
